summary:
Sempra 上季 EPS 0.54 美元大幅低於預期68%、營收 37.5 億美元，特殊項目與費率時點重創帳面獲利。
• 營收 37.5 億美元，受監管事業基本盤仍在
• 費率基礎與基礎建設投資長期支撐
• LNG 出口業務具長期成長潛力
• 加州與德州電網投資持續
ai_view:
訊號偏弱：EPS 大幅低於預期，對穩定的受監管公用事業而言異常，須釐清是否含一次性項目、費率時點或減損，而非經常性獲利惡化。短期股價可能承壓，市場將檢視管理層對全年指引的維持。中期追蹤費率基礎成長、監管裁決、LNG 專案進度與經常性 EPS 回穩。31倍本益比放大了任何獲利不確定性的估值風險。

需留意：EPS 大幅低於預期，恐含特殊項目或費率時點干擾；本期未提供營收年增率，成長能見度有限；監管與利率環境壓力，估值偏高

summary_en:
Sempra posted EPS of $0.54, missing by 68% on $3.75B revenue, as special items and rate timing hit reported earnings.
• Revenue of $3.75B with the regulated base intact
• Rate base and infrastructure investment provide long-term support
• LNG export business offers long-term growth potential
• Continued grid investment in California and Texas

ai_view_en:
Signal is weak: a 68% EPS miss is unusual for a stable regulated utility and warrants clarity on whether special items, rate timing or impairments are involved rather than recurring deterioration. Near term the stock may be pressured, with the market watching whether full-year guidance holds. Mid term, track rate-base growth, regulatory decisions, LNG progress and a return to normalized EPS. A ~31x P/E amplifies valuation risk from any earnings uncertainty.

Watch：Large EPS miss likely reflects special items or rate timing; Revenue YoY not provided, limiting growth visibility; Regulatory and rate pressures with an elevated valuation
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 大幅低於預期 67.97%，獲利顯著不及估計（營收年增率未提供）。
